name: Hotel Abhishek
description: Local favorite serving classic South Indian breakfast and hearty afternoon meals. Known for quick service and authentic local flavors.

name: Hotel Annapurneshwari
description: Authentic Karnataka style vegetarian meals. Famous for their soft idlis, crispy vada, and wholesome unlimited afternoon thalis.

name: Hotel Paniraj
description: A popular stop for fresh filter coffee, crispy dosas, and quick South Indian snacks. Clean, family-friendly, and budget-friendly.

name: Raghu Hotel
description: Famous for their crispy Masala Dosa and fresh filter coffee. A traditional local mess serving authentic home-style South Indian food since 1995.

name: NEMINATH JAIN BHOJNALAYA
description: Experience delicious, strictly prepared Jain food crafted without root vegetables, onions, and garlic. Open every day until 10:00 PM. Traveling soon? We also accept pre-orders for parcels so you can enjoy pure food on the go!
